snippet.title: Nano Neighbors - Official Announcement Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2025
snippet.description:
Customise your nano, their capsule home, meet up with friends & relax in this online desktop idle sim.
Nano Neighbors will be coming to PC later this year, so head over to Steam and add it to your wishlist.
